documents.text: Telegram polling fetches updates with a persistent offset. Deduplicate update_id before enqueueing a task so restarts do not execute it twice.
Telegram authorization checks the numeric allowed user ID and private chat type before parsing any command. Reject commands from groups or unknown users.
Codex authentication uses official device-code login under the service account. Reuse saved ChatGPT authentication; never copy cached OAuth tokens into another client.
Sandbox startup failure occurs before the policy start marker. Check bubblewrap installation and targeted AppArmor namespace permissions on Ubuntu before blaming candidate code.
A SQLite transaction commits related state updates atomically. Roll back both the accepted-version pointer and promotion record if either update fails.
Queue idempotency uses a unique client job ID. Repeated submissions return the existing job instead of creating another model worker.
Lease recovery checks worker identity and heartbeat expiry. Reconcile surviving processes before marking a stale job interrupted or assigning it to another worker.
Quota exhaustion pauses new model work while preserving job state. Store the reported reset time when present; missing usage telemetry means unknown usage.
The policy protocol accepts query, document IDs and text, experience, and a context limit. Output only selected_ids and instructions; the supervisor validates and builds context.
Evaluation labels and expected evidence IDs remain in the trusted grader. Never include answer labels in a policy request or writable candidate workspace.
Promotion requires passing fixed regression checks and an eligible patch. A better retrieval score never overrides a failing regression test.
Rollback changes the active accepted-version pointer to an earlier immutable archive version. Verify its digest before activation and preserve the rejected version's metrics.
A systemd service supervises the persistent worker under a dedicated user. Restart after process failure, handle SIGTERM cleanly, and keep credentials in a protected environment file.
A Git worktree creates a separate candidate checkout from a fixed commit. The main checkout stays clean; keep the base revision and patch digest with each candidate.
The context budget bounds the characters delivered to the model. Include only complete evidence blocks that fit and report the actual resulting context size.
A memory ablation compares the same policy with retrieved experience enabled and disabled on identical cases. Hold model settings and budgets constant before claiming memory improves outcomes.
Audit separation requires fresh labels outside the optimizer's readable files. Once audit failures guide improvements, retire those cases from the final held-out set.
Process cancellation terminates the entire child process group. Preserve logs and interrupted state so a timeout does not leave hidden model workers running.
